title: Fully justified web text and irregular word spacing
statement:
Fully justified text on web pages causes irregular word spacing ('rivers of white') which severely disrupts reading flow for users with cognitive or visual impairments.

Options:
- Ragged-Right (LTR Languages): text-align: left; (fits: standard web, accessible content, blogs)
- Ragged-Left (RTL Languages): text-align: right; (fits: arabic localization, hebrew localization)
- Full Justification (Avoid on Web): text-align: justify; (fits: print magazines, pdf reports)
- Center Alignment: text-align: center; (fits: short headings, hero text, pull quotes)
appliesWhen: Applies to: web, digital documents. Audience: general, adults, children under 10, seniors.

source.title: Understanding Success Criterion 1.4.8 Visual Presentation
source.authors: W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines Working Group
